|strategy=By Paul Evans<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/mindtricksdontworkonme.html</ref>

The one-turn beatdown has become a devastating maneuver used to decimate the Dark Side for years. Not any more with this card. With this card on the table, it sets up a safety blanket for the Dark Side, allowing them to leave a location a little thinner than they would like to, just the same as with a [[Ghhhk]]. Best of all, it is an Effect and cannot be denied use by the [[Frozen Assets]]/[[Draw Their Fire]] or [[Beggar]]/[[Draw Their Fire]] combos widely used in today's metagame.

Even better, this card can be used offensively by dropping an Enhanced character to take care of [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] or taking on the entire scout beatdown crew on [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] to remove Midge from play. Either way it is used, the tricks the Light Side has won't work on this card.
|rulings=* Cards that cannot be forfeited (such as a character not participating in battle, or a [[Floating Refinery]]) do not prevent a player from canceling all remaining battle damage.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json card data], entry <code>12_136</code>, <code>rulings</code> field. A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 25 January 2018. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Cor-D-mindtricksdontworkonme-PC-Errata-2018-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Mind Tricks Don't Work On Me (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again, with the printed art, title and lore (350 × 490 pixels); a small round bronze disc at the lower right marks it as errata.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 disc card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
